We are a sports massage training organisation and on this Channel you can see lots of demos that will help you learn new techniques and improve existing skills as well as find out more about what we offer prospective students.

We teach Level 3 Sports Massage to beginners - by the end of the course students are able to plan, prepare, and apply sports massage therapy to prevent injury and improve performance http://www.sportstherapyuk.com/level3 For those who aren't sure whether Sports Massage is for them, we offer an intro to spots massage day http://www.sportstherapyuk.com/intro

Our Level 4 Sports Massage course builds on Level 3 and gives students the skills and knowledge to assess and treat injuries. Finally at Level 5 students incorporate more advanced and diverse skills to their learning - from assessing gait, utilising special tests on joints, creating comprehensive rehabilitation programmes, as well as treating with advanced soft tissue techniques.
